description: RAG evaluation set built from knowledge-base/ (Sanity dataset 'development', exported 2026-10-14). relevantDocIds are Sanity document IDs (frontmatter sanity_id). Reference answers and expected claims are quoted or closely paraphrased from the source documents. Abstention cases ask about information that does not exist in the knowledge base. Changelog: 1.1.0 — multi-security-integrations: added pages/security.md (919f074c) and faqs/does-steer-integrate-with-our-ehr.md (4cc4ca24) as relevant; both state the security posture / EHR integrations asked about (labels were incomplete in 1.0.0). 1.2.0 — added faq-ehr-systems-phrasing (regression: this phrasing abstained in manual testing because the answer FAQ ranked 6th with RAG_MAX_SOURCES=5). 1.3.0 — added faq-ehr-systems-short (regression: abstained in the live benchmark; the answer is in the integrations FAQ and the security page).

cases.question: How much does Steer cost?
cases.referenceAnswer: Small-practice options start at a low retainer; pricing is flexible and assessed on a call.
expectedClaims: Small-practice options start at a low retainer
Book a call to assess the best pricing model

cases.question: How long is the setup time?
cases.referenceAnswer: On average about 4 weeks from the start of discussions to full commissioning.
expectedClaims: An average of 4 weeks from start of discussions to full commissioning

cases.question: How much work does Steer need from my side to get set up?
cases.referenceAnswer: A maximum of 10-15 hours from the appointed point of contact.
expectedClaims: A maximum of 10-15 hours from the appointed point of contact

cases.question: Which systems do you integrate with?
cases.referenceAnswer: Epic, Cerner, Athena, NextGen, Power2Practice and others, plus payors, lab networks, payments and telephony.
expectedClaims: payors, lab networks, payments, and telephony

cases.question: Which EHR systems does Steer Health integrate with?
cases.referenceAnswer: Epic, Cerner, Athena, NextGen, Power2Practice and others, plus payors, lab networks, payments and telephony.

cases.question: Which EHR systems does Steer integrate with?
cases.referenceAnswer: Epic, Cerner and Athena (the integrations FAQ also lists NextGen and Power2Practice).

cases.question: How does Steer connect to our EHR?
cases.referenceAnswer: Steer connects via HL7/FHIR and APIs, working alongside existing systems, and exchanges appointment data with the EHR to automate workflows.

cases.question: How secure is patient data with Steer Health?
cases.referenceAnswer: Steer Health is a HIPAA-compliant and SOC2-certified all-in-one platform; security is its cornerstone.

cases.question: What is Steer Health?
cases.referenceAnswer: An AI-powered growth and automation platform for healthcare organizations.
expectedClaims: AI-powered growth and automation platform for healthcare organizations

cases.question: Who is Steer Health for?
cases.referenceAnswer: A large variety of health organizations, from hospitals, surgical centers and urgent care centers to medical groups and MedSpas.

cases.question: What do T-21, T-14 and T-7 mean?
cases.referenceAnswer: Time-based checkpoints 21, 14 and 7 days before surgery used to lock in readiness (prep, PAT, benefits and logistics).
expectedClaims: Used to lock in readiness: prep, PAT, benefits, logistics

cases.question: Will Steer replace my front desk team?
cases.referenceAnswer: No; it replaces repetitive manual tasks so the team can focus on high-value patient support, acting as a force multiplier.
expectedClaims: Replaces repetitive manual tasks, not the team

cases.question: What exactly is Steer Elevate?
cases.referenceAnswer: Steer Health's specialized growth platform for Functional Medicine that automates patient access, follow-ups and revenue workflows.
expectedClaims: Specialized growth platform for Functional Medicine
Automates patient access, follow-ups, and revenue workflows

cases.question: How does Steer manage advanced labs like DUTCH or GI-MAP?
cases.referenceAnswer: Steer centralizes lab ordering, tracking and result review, and results can be tied to protocols and care plans.
expectedClaims: Centralizes lab ordering, tracking, and result review

cases.question: What happens if we run into technical issues?
cases.referenceAnswer: Contact the central support line, staffed almost 24/7; the customer success team also supports you.

cases.question: How fast is deployment for hospitals?
cases.referenceAnswer: Hospitals typically launch within weeks, starting with one service line and expanding from there.
expectedClaims: Start with one service line and expand

cases.question: Does this replace our pre-admission team?
cases.referenceAnswer: No, it elevates them: Steer automates routine touches and surfaces only the exceptions.
expectedClaims: Automates routine touches and surfaces exceptions

cases.question: Is Steer an EHR replacement?
cases.referenceAnswer: No; it is a system of execution layered on your EHR, and Elevate overlays existing EHRs without rip-and-replace.
expectedClaims: Layered on / overlays the existing EHR

cases.question: Will Steer support a membership and program-based business model?
cases.referenceAnswer: Yes. Steer is built for memberships, packages and high-ticket programs, not just fee-for-service.
expectedClaims: Built for memberships, packages, and high-ticket programs

cases.question: What is AI Front Door and what results does it deliver?
cases.referenceAnswer: AI Front Door helps patients find care and book faster, with +36% more bookings, +22% new patient acquisition and an 86% drop in no-shows.

cases.question: What features does AI Front Door include, like symptom checking or scheduling?
cases.referenceAnswer: Digital Discovery, a Symptom Checker recognizing 300+ conditions, Smart Scheduling, Care Access routing, AI Conversations, and reminders and follow-ups.
expectedClaims: Smart Scheduling reduces scheduling time by 70%
Care Access routes patients with 90% accuracy

cases.question: What can the Luna virtual assistant do?
cases.referenceAnswer: SteerLuna answers, authenticates, schedules and handles refills in under 60 seconds; it matches callers to their EHR account and escalates when a human is needed.
expectedClaims: Answer, authenticate, schedule, and refill in under 60 seconds
Matches callers to their EHR account
Escalates requests needing a human touch

cases.question: How many inquiries does Luna automate?
cases.referenceAnswer: 68% of inquiries automated, 9.6M queries handled and 75% abandonment reduced.

cases.question: What is SteerNotes and how much time does it save?
cases.referenceAnswer: SteerNotes records and transcribes conversations into documentation, with 80% admin reduced, 3X faster notes and 60% cost savings.

cases.question: How does SteerKiosk check-in work?
cases.referenceAnswer: Patients scan or tap to begin on smartphones or kiosks without logins, autofill forms and pay; results include 50% cash flow up and 80% faster check-in.
expectedClaims: Scan or tap to begin, no logins needed

cases.question: What is FastTrackCare for emergency rooms?
cases.referenceAnswer: FastTrackCare lets patients reserve an ER arrival time via QR, link or text and check in digitally, with 72% tasks automated and 36% wait reduced.
expectedClaims: Select an ER arrival time by QR, link, or text

cases.question: What does Steer Concierge do for inpatients?
cases.referenceAnswer: Patients request meals, meds or support via the Concierge app; staff see and respond on a dashboard; results include 40% workload down and 30% satisfaction up.
expectedClaims: Patients request meals, meds, or support via the app

cases.question: How does Steer Health help hospitals and health systems?
cases.referenceAnswer: AI that gets patients to the right care fast: 24/7 engagement across voice, text and web, triage, eligibility verification and direct booking, with solutions such as AI Front Door and AI Voice for access centers.
expectedClaims: Engage patients 24/7 across voice, text, and web

cases.question: What results do hospitals typically see with Steer Health?
cases.referenceAnswer: 18-25% increase in new patient conversions, 20-30% fewer call-center workloads and 25% fewer no-shows.

cases.question: How does Steer help ambulatory surgery centers keep ORs full?
cases.referenceAnswer: It automates pre-op intake, verifies eligibility and backfills cancellations to boost OR utilization, including OR block optimization and smart backfill.

cases.question: What does Steer offer medical groups?
cases.referenceAnswer: AI that gets patients to the right visit fast: AI Front Door, AI Voice for scheduling, and eligibility and estimates.

cases.question: Why do functional medicine clinics choose Steer Health?
cases.referenceAnswer: An AI-powered patient engagement platform purpose-built for functional medicine, with an AI growth engine and dynamic forms that auto-populate from EHR data.
expectedClaims: Purpose built for Functional Medicine clinics
AI Growth Engine targets high-intent patients
Dynamic forms auto-populate from EHR data

cases.question: When was Steer Health founded and by whom?
cases.referenceAnswer: Founded in 2021 by Sridhar Yerramreddy.

cases.question: How many patients and organizations does Steer Health serve?
cases.referenceAnswer: 19M+ patients and 360+ organizations (as of 2025).

cases.question: Is Steer Health SOC 2 Type II certified?
cases.referenceAnswer: Yes, Steer Health is SOC 2 Type II certified.

cases.question: What is Steer Health's mission?
cases.referenceAnswer: To make healthcare instantly accessible by eliminating the operational barriers that delay treatment, lose patients and burn out medical staff.

cases.question: Is Steer secure and compliant, and which EHRs does it integrate with?
cases.referenceAnswer: It is HIPAA-ready and enterprise-secure with encryption and audit trails, and integrates with Epic, Cerner, Athena, NextGen, Power2Practice and others.
expectedClaims: SOC 2 Type II certified or enterprise-grade security

cases.question: What is the difference between Luna and AI Front Door?
cases.referenceAnswer: Luna is a voice/chat assistant that answers calls, authenticates, schedules and refills; AI Front Door helps patients find care online through search, symptom checking and self-scheduling.
expectedClaims: Luna handles calls: answer, authenticate, schedule, refill
AI Front Door helps patients find care and book online
